lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical high-contrast white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is relatively uniform with a slight decrease in interval distance towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 10th vertical line from the anterior, splitting into a Y-shape at the mid-torso level; a minor divergence is also visible at the dorsal origin of the 11th line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Dashed line segments observed in the posterior-most 3 lines; lines 1 and 2 in the anterior region terminate abruptly before reaching the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 7 high-contrast white spots located on the upper posterior haunch, exhibiting a high-density grouping above the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of 3 spots on the mid-thigh, creating a semi-connected geometric line segment parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking across the nasal bridge; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek; a broad white patch at the base of the neck.
